_comment: UNFILLED template of the external approval payload for the Shopify release gate (scripts/operators/shopify_release_gate.py). This file is NOT read by the gate and is not part of the pinned inventory. The owner copies it OUTSIDE the repository, fills every field for exactly one release commit, one source inventory, one platform target, one backup and one deployment phase (S0 or S3), stores the filled JSON base64-encoded in the service variable NAHLA_SHOPIFY_RELEASE_APPROVAL_B64, and renders the pre-deploy command with `shopify_release_gate_render.py render --approval-file <filled.json>`, which pins the payload's SHA-256 in the command. `deployment_rollback_snapshot` is the deployment that would be redeployed to withdraw the release; it is not database recovery. `db_recovery_evidence.backup` is an observed completed backup card for exactly the expected database service and volume (not proof of recovery); it must be completed, restore-available, observed before the approval and no older than BACKUP_MAX_AGE_HOURS at approval and at run time. `restore_verified` is required true, with reference and timestamp between the backup and the approval, for the schema-changing phase S3. Timestamps are UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.
